# Navimower Map Card 0.3.2

Navimower Map Card 0.3.2 is the cumulative stable release of the 0.3.2 beta line. It promotes the tested beta2 runtime directly; no beta version needs to be installed first.

## Mower artwork

The map can now match the mower shown in Home Assistant to the actual Navimow family instead of always using the original H-series drawing.

- `mower_icon: auto` detects H1/H2, i-series, i2 LiDAR, X3 and X4 models.
- The visual editor exposes the same automatic choice plus manual overrides, including light/dark i-series artwork.
- All artwork is embedded in the existing single HACS JavaScript runtime; there are no extra image downloads at runtime.
- Automatic detection is flicker-safe: if the model is not already available from entity attributes, the mower stays hidden during the short device-registry lookup instead of briefly flashing the H1/H2 fallback.
- Manual icon selections still render immediately.

## Better History navigation

- `history_days` accepts 1 through 31 and defaults to 3 calendar days.
- History keeps every configured day selectable even when no mowing session exists for that date.
- Selecting a date shows all sessions from that day instead of applying the old maximum-session limit.
- `show_session_legend` now controls only the row of session-time buttons.
- Existing `session_count` YAML is tolerated for compatibility but no longer limits History.

## Documentation refresh

The stable release also refreshes README and `examples/` so the public documentation matches the current card: dedicated Resume behavior, scrollable Notifications with `notification_count`, current VisionFence/Gate options, current History settings, single-runtime HACS installation and mower-artwork configuration. Obsolete tunnel/session-count examples have been removed.

## Compatibility

- Existing map geometry, daily trails, live route, Schedule editor, Notifications, Resume/Mow/Pause/Dock controls, zone details, VF-off visibility, zoom/navigation and visual settings are retained.
- Navimower integration 0.4.2 or later is recommended for the complete notification read-action and dedicated Resume feature set.
- The card continues to ship as one `navimower-map-card.js` HACS runtime file, with `src/` and `dist/` kept byte-for-byte identical by the build.

0.3.2 is the stable promotion of the tested 0.3.2-beta2 runtime plus documentation/example cleanup; there is no separate runtime redesign in the stable step.
